mapper.sql: bu.building_unit_id,bu.building_id, COALESCE(b.building_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼')) AS building_name, bu.unit_no,bu.unit_name,bu.status,bu.version,bu.created_at,bu.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p WHERE p.building_unit_id=bu.building_unit_id) AS property_count
mapper.update: UPDATE building_unit SET unit_name=#{entity.unitName},status=COALESCE(#{entity.status},status),version=version+1 WHERE building_unit_id=#{buildingUnitId} AND version=#{entity.version}
